title: analysis.opportunity.invalidated.v1
description: SKELETON, not yet wired into any service (docs/adr/007-shared-cross-service-contracts.md). Published by analysis-engine when a previously-published opportunity (analysis.opportunity.v1) is no longer valid — its invalidation price traded through, it expired, or the structure it was based on was itself invalidated. algo-bot's analysis_client uses this to retire a Candidate it may have already started evaluating. Deliberately a separate, minimal event rather than re-publishing the full opportunity with a status flag — a consumer that only cares about invalidation should not need the full Candidate shape.

opportunity_id.description: Matches the id field of the analysis.opportunity.v1 event being invalidated.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code, same discipline as opportunity-v1's evidence.code — e.g. "invalidation_price_traded_through", "expired", "structure_invalidated".
